title: Factory Droid client <-> daemon protocol (daemon)
description: The daemon <-> client surface: every daemon.* request, response and notification frame. References shared.schema.json and droid.schema.json. Generated from the Zod schemas in @factory/droid-sdk-core. Every distinct protocol schema is a definition, named after its most upstream export; reference one with #/definitions/<Name>. Request definitions carry x-factory-response (and/or x-factory-result) naming their response definition. Wire frames are expressed as allOf: [{$ref: JsonRpcEnvelopeSchema}, {frame-specific properties}]. Values marked x-factory-runtime-only are validated more strictly at runtime than this document can express.
